name: Tallybook
description: Crafting shopping list, villager quest tracker, spoiler-free story guide, and world reference. Pin any item for live inventory-tracked counts, have fetch errands picked up and mapped automatically, and follow the vanilla story one revealed step at a time. Optional World tab shows every world-config rule this world runs with (and every mod, with versions); optional Player tab tracks your spawn points — world spawn and temporal-gear returning point, with map markers and respawns left — plus deaths and more. Fully client-side, works on any server, supports every content mod's recipes and errands with zero compat patches.
